_comment: Everything company-specific lives here. Copy this file, change the company, categories and capabilities, and the bot, jobs and site all follow it.

company.name: Keelstone
company.oneLiner: Computer vision on the cameras you already have, plus the coaching, OSHA and renewal reporting that turn hazards into fewer claims.
proofPoints: No new hardware: runs on existing IP cameras, about one day of setup per site
Faces and bodies blurred at the edge; video used for coaching, never discipline
Works with any carrier and any broker
Broker-ready renewal report with leading indicators by site

categories.name: AI safety analytics
categories.description: Computer-vision and sensor companies selling safety software directly to employers.

categories.name: Insurtech
categories.description: Tech-first workers' comp insurers and MGAs that bundle risk tools with coverage.
capabilities: Leading indicators, not just loss runs

categories.name: Insurance carriers
categories.description: Established workers' comp carriers whose loss-control services compete for the same safety budget and attention.

slack._adminUserIds: Slack member IDs of the people who approve intel, card requests and source lists. The first one also gets change alerts and monthly drafts.

site.title: Competitive Intel Tracker
site._showEmployeeSentiment: Glassdoor and CEO approval are an admin signal. Keep this false unless the site is private to your team.

monthly._weekday: 0 = Sunday. 2 = Tuesday. The job runs on the first one of each month.

industryQuestions.trends: What changed in workplace safety technology and workers' compensation this month that a sales rep should know?
industryQuestions.regulatory: What OSHA, state workers' comp, privacy or AI regulations were proposed, passed or enforced this month?
industryQuestions.mna: What mergers, acquisitions, funding rounds or shutdowns happened among workers' comp insurers, insurtechs and safety-tech companies this month?
industryQuestions.health: How healthy is the workers' comp market right now: rates, combined ratios, claim frequency and severity trends?

movers._comment: How 'movement' is scored when picking the top movers per category. Severity sets the base, type multiplies it.

claude._model: Override with the CLAUDE_MODEL environment variable.
